details:
Q1. Which single area of this repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement pipeline behavior
B. Review / autofix / orchestrate / validate behavior
C. Docs / README / runbooks only
D. A specific workflow, script, or file path — please name it explicitly (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What outcome do you want for that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug or regression — include current behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or extend functionality — describe the new behavior you want
C. Improve reliability / performance / cost without changing behavior — describe the pain point
D. Improve readability / docs / maintainability — describe the concrete deficiency
Q3. What should planning use as the acceptance signal?
Choices:
A. A specific issue / PR / workflow run / log example that shows the problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. A short before/after behavior example
C. A precise acceptance criterion or checklist
D. Best-effort improvement with no additional acceptance criteria
